method.frameSampler: Independent rAF observer, including idle menus; all raw intervals retained. No renderer/canvas wrappers in timed samples.
method.tails: p99 frame time is the equivalent tail metric; low1FPS = 1000 / mean slowest ceil(1% of intervals). Missed60HzSlots is an estimate from rounded intervals, not a compositor dropped-frame counter.
method.cpu: CDP Performance task/script/layout/style counters; heap samples every second, forced-GC heap before/after retained separately from in-window allocation samples.
method.input: Trusted keydown -> first rAF observing changed domain position, includes dispatch and game update but is not hardware input-to-photon.
method.cold: New context (empty HTTP cache) navigation->start dialog and Begin/Continue->ready. OS/disk caches not flushed.
